description_en: The UpgradeMinorVersion operation upgrades the minor engine version of a specified community-compatible ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用UpgradeMinorVersion接口升级指定云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群的内核小版本
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse upgrade-minor-version --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --upgrade-immediately false --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeMinorVersion

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to upgrade the minor engine version immediately. Valid values:

true: The minor engine version is upgraded immediately.

false: The minor engine version is upgraded at a specified time or within the maintenance window.

The UpgradeTime parameter is required if you want to upgrade the minor engine version at a specified time
parameters.help_zh:
是否立即升级，取值说明：

true：立即升级。

false：指定时间升级或可维护时间升级。

如果是指定时间升级内核小版本，那么UpgradeTime为必填项
parameters.name: upgrade_immediately

parameters.help_en:
The minor engine version to which you want to upgrade.

If you do not specify this parameter, the cluster is upgraded to the latest minor engine version
parameters.help_zh:
升级的内核小版本号。
默认不填写，直接升级到最新的内核小版本
parameters.name: upgrade_version

parameters.help_en:
The time to perform the upgrade. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If you do not specify this parameter, the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster is upgraded within the maintenance window
parameters.help_zh:
指定的升级时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
当不填写该参数时，则云数据库ClickHouse集群将在可维护时间内进行内核小版本升级
parameters.name: upgrade_time
